purposeKo: 거친 프로젝트 요청과 새 작업의 계속 진행 요청을 JOENESS-0.1이 실제 구현, 검증, 파일 기반 인수인계로 변환하는지 원본과 분리된 MergeDrop 프로젝트에서 관찰한다.

comparisonBoundary.reason: Windows Codex CWD 격리 문제로 엄격한 두 팔 A/B는 별도 평가에서 중단됐다. 이번 실행은 JOENESS 베타의 실사용 가능성과 결함을 찾는 단일 팔 파일럿이다.

infrastructureIncident.observed: The first fresh worker's tool workdir resolved to D:/JOEWRKS/JOEWRKS-TestProject-01.
infrastructureIncident.response: The worker stopped before reading or writing. One read-only preflight proved that an explicit Set-Location inside every PowerShell command resolved to the pilot root; all subsequent worker commands used that prefix.
infrastructureIncident.classification: infrastructure limitation, not product or harness performance

phase1.promptKo: MergeDrop을 실제 Google Play 출시 목표로 진행해줘. 현재 상태를 파악하고 가장 적절한 다음 단계를 스스로 정해서, 계획으로만 끝내지 말고 이번 단계에 검증 가능한 산출물까지 만들어줘.
phase1.selectedOutcome: Dependency-free portrait browser vertical slice with deterministic lane-based merge rules.
verifiedStrengths: Produced a runnable artifact rather than stopping at a generic plan.
Separated deterministic rules from browser rendering and platform glue.
Left executable tests for merge, scoring, preview, persistence, game over, invalid input, and restart.
Explicitly denied Android build, signed package, store readiness, and publication claims.
Created a compact evidence-linked handoff for a fresh worker.
verifiedLimitations: No APK/AAB, Android shell, device run, signing, Play Console, or store evidence.
The provisional deterministic-lane feel was not an approved production product decision.
No exact token or command-count telemetry was available.

phase2.selectedOutcome: Recover Phase 1 from files and evidence, then create a focused owner decision gate before changing physics or Android stack.
verifiedStrengths: Recovered the current phase from Git, files, tests, and the handoff without prior conversation.
Did not duplicate or replace the verified Phase 1 implementation.
Distinguished PowerShell decoding mojibake from actual UTF-8 corruption and did not perform a false repair.
Recommended the reversible lane route while preserving one material owner decision.
Reported PARTIAL and repeated the missing Android and release evidence.
verifiedLimitations: Added governance documents but no Android artifact or build-path evidence.
Called the decision gate evidence-backed without recording a fresh Phase 2 play-through.
The free-body route was analyzed architecturally rather than compared with a second playable feel prototype.
No exact token or command-count telemetry was available.

stopJudgment.reason: Free-body physics would replace placement, collision, game-over semantics, test strategy, engine choice, and likely Android packaging. The worker still made a recommendation and asked one focused owner question instead of offloading all judgment.
stopJudgment.becomesExcessiveWhen: The same unanswered gate is repeated or safe direction-neutral work is refused after the owner chooses.

freshChecks.viewport360x640: canvas 322x358.390625; aspect ratio 0.898 instead of intended 9/13

infrastructureExclusions: The in-app browser resolved 127.0.0.1:4173 to an unrelated app during review; that surface was excluded and the server was cleaned up.

importantFindings.finding: The independent max-height cap distorts the fixed 9:13 canvas on a plausible 360x640 Android viewport.
The static canvas label does not expose selected lane or current board state before a drop.

minorFindings: Automated tests do not cover UI wiring, responsiveness, keyboard integration, or HTTP behavior.
The local static server can serve non-runtime repository files such as AGENTS.md.
The fixed 360x520 canvas backing store has no device-pixel-ratio scaling.

retain: rough-request conversion into the smallest useful verified phase
truthful completion and explicit unverified work
one focused owner gate for material product-direction changes
narrowCandidatesForNextRevision: For meaningful UI, verify the shortest supported viewport and preserve game-surface aspect ratio.
When a fresh continuation calls a gameplay or feel gate evidence-backed, require fresh direct interaction or label inherited interaction evidence explicitly.
doNotAdd: new central router or global Common Core
more generic verification rules that duplicate native Codex behavior
decision.causationLimit: This single-arm pilot shows compatible behavior and concrete defects but does not prove that JOENESS caused the gains or outperforms Native Codex.
